title: France bans Israel’s finance minister, slams him for promoting ‘recolonisation’ of Gaza
summary: France on Tuesday banned Israel’s Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich from entry, slamming the far-right politician’s calls for the annexation of the occupied West Bank, new settlements in the area and the “recolonisation” of Gaza.
